scenario.description: Lila needs someone to care for her cat during a short trip and must decide whether to accept a neighbor's offer of pet sitting in exchange for a bicycle tune-up, while settling the care instructions and household errands.

shared_context.S1: Lila will be away from June 14 through June 19 and needs someone to care for her cat, Juniper, at her apartment.
shared_context.S2: Lila decides whether to accept an arrangement and records the final terms.
shared_context.S3: Marcus has offered to help with Juniper, and Lila can tune up bicycles as an informal favor.
shared_context.S4: Juniper appears healthy and normally stays inside the apartment.
shared_context.S5: Before Lila records the final terms, everyone reviews the proposed exchange and confirms the veterinary care instructions for Juniper.

PF1.text: Marcus's concrete proposal is to stay at Lila's apartment for exactly 5 nights from June 14 through June 19, receive a bicycle tune-up instead of cash, and water Lila's 6 balcony plants once each day.

PF2.text: Tess learned from Juniper's veterinarian yesterday, and has not shared it with Lila or Marcus, that Juniper must receive exactly 2 ml of liquid medicine at 08:00 and 20:00 each day and must remain indoors throughout the trip.

acceptance_conditions: The arrangement must be accepted with Marcus as the sitter.
The stay must run from June 14 through June 19 for exactly 5 nights.
The exchange must be a bicycle tune-up with no cash payment.
Marcus must commit to watering exactly 6 balcony plants once daily.
Juniper must receive exactly 2 ml of medicine at 08:00 and 20:00 each day.
Juniper must remain indoors throughout the trip.
Tess's veterinary information must be cited as justification for the medication and indoor-care requirements.

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's revealed proposal changes the partner to Marcus, fixes the June 14-June 19 five-night stay, sets cash payment to 0 with a bicycle tune-up, and sets daily watering to exactly 6 plants.
Tess's revealed veterinary information changes the care plan to exactly 2 ml at 08:00 and 20:00 and changes the cat rule to mandatory indoor care, while supplying the fact that Lila must cite.
